text: {"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'bul' (gambling/dice) in the list of the elder brother's vices; only revelry and women are rendered"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ma hakotzil ca chacanacentii (do not marvel that I resemble him) -> 'Do not be afraid that I appear to you'", "cici tħan Dioz (sweet/good word of God) -> 'holy word of God'", "maix tan û Kantal û yatal tauol (it will not be long before grief weighs on your heart) -> 'your heart will not fail to grieve with regret'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["<meta> content quoting the previous page: 'Now, the younger one was very devoted to this study and to virtuous paths; he did not meddle with' (this text is not on this page)"], "mistranslated": ["tacitac û tuculic (he soon/immediately thought) -> 'he was on the verge of thinking'", "yoklaliix à meyahul (for your service/use) -> 'for thy sake'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B keeps details A drops or gets wrong, namely 'bul' (gambling) and 'ma hakotzil' (do not marvel that I resemble him), and its only addition is supposed previous-page text placed in a meta tag."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'ta uoleex' (believe 'in your hearts' in dreams and bird songs)", "'hebal c tucliceex' (a dream is the image of 'what we think about'), which is left out of the account of dreams"], "added": ["<gloss>Henry of Ghent</gloss> and the note identifying Enrique Gran as Henricus Gandavensis, an identification that is very likely false"], "mistranslated": ["bai u peec xan heklae (just so it moves too) -> 'and it stops moving as well'", "hunpelili Diozil y lay Yumbile (He is one God with the Father) -> 'divinity is one and the same'", "u uaiazba hebal c tucliceex a hanonexe (a fantasy of what we think while awake) -> 'delusions that come when we sleep'", "maix uchac u tabli (nor can He be deceived) -> 'it cannot deceive'", "hach chacan tech (very like you / very clear to you) -> 'very clearly' (minor)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["'intensely' (a free rendering of 'Calam'; minor)"], "mistranslated": ["u pel mehen Dioze (the Son of God) -> 'the only-begotten Son of God' (a slight over-reading)", "a booi (your shadow/reflection), rendered as 'shadow', is acceptable but literal"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B covers the whole page and gets the dream passage and the 'cannot deceive / cannot be deceived' pair right, while A has several errors of sense and wrongly identifies Enrique Gran as Henry of Ghent."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["as a shadow", "may be made complete"], "mistranslated": ["remember you have already passed through other, greater (sicknesses) -> \"remember that after you endure it, other and greater things will come\"", "beauty much desired by alakoob (companions/dependents) -> \"so coveted by the women\"", "his heart/breath returned to its place (he was calmed) -> \"When these words entered into the sick man's heart\"", "the younger brother, with great sorrow and tears in his eyes, said -> the sorrow and tears are given to the sick man instead"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["tenderness and"], "mistranslated": ["St. Bernard says God's mercy will see you turned back -> \"He is the mercy of God\" (makes the Holy Spirit the mercy of God)", "his appearance was very clear to those two who were passing [the night] -> \"whose countenance was very clearly like unto those two who had passed before\"", "a note about Zucun that wrongly claims the older brother is speaking to the younger brother"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is fuller and gets the brother's speech right, including the line about earlier, greater sicknesses, which A gets wrong; A also changes 'alakoob' to 'women' and adds a few small embellishments."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'Zanili' (only): A says 'this true God... already was' instead of 'only this true God existed'"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["caat nucabti tumen Espiritu S. (then he was answered by the Holy Spirit) -> 'Then He answered him, through the Holy Spirit'", "y u yabal Zakcil hebixten (and one of much affliction such as I) -> 'with such radiant whiteness, unto one such as I'", "xic àtzolic balyan à uale ti à uotoch (go and set in order what you have in your house) -> 'whatsoever thou hast to declare in thy house'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'tu pazel' (to the dwelling of): B says only 'visit'"], "added": ["\"magnificent youthful form\""], "mistranslated": ["yokol u noh celembal (upon his right shoulder) -> 'above His magnificent youthful form'", "cu ualKezic u yich (turns back the face) -> 'turning aside the anger'", "tan celem pal (a young man in his prime) -> 'a handsome youth'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both are complete and close to the source, but B misreads 'u noh celembal' (his right shoulder) as 'magnificent youthful form', while A's slips are smaller."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["<meta> quotes text from the previous page (\"...that not only the Father and the Son are to be reverenced, and honored, and loved by us, but also\"), which is not on this page"], "mistranslated": ["cu yuchul lay ú cha campahal ta uuyahexloe (this comes about through the teaching you have heard) -> \"Thus is fulfilled that which takes firm hold in what ye have heard\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["along with them"], "mistranslated": ["tumtabale (temptation/trial) -> \"temptation\" is acceptable, but the syntax 'Our Lord God, seeing ... the only Son of God descended' leaves the sentence broken (minor)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both are complete and mostly accurate, but B renders the 'teaching you have heard' clause correctly where A garbles it; B's only slip is the small addition 'along with them'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["in their churches"], "mistranslated": ["ú ɔálpach (turn their backs on / abandon) the devotions and prayers -> \"wish to follow the devotions and prayers\"", "nuculilóob (means, instruments) -> \"intentions\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["tu tiƀlilóob (properly / in their due form) after the prayers"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["See now whether that same habit does not confirm it -> \"See now whether, if it is constantly delayed, it does not settle\"", "le napzah (habit) -> \"neglect\"", "le mazuƀtalil (shamelessness) -> \"shame is born\"", "cheh ƀacilil (skeleton, bones) of a Christian -> \"a mockery of a Christian\"", "how much easier the resurrection would have been if, as soon as the soul fell and died, they had called on Jesus Christ -> \"how very difficult would a resurrection be if that soul should fall and die, unless they quickly call upon Jesus Christ\"", "chac uyenil (red swelling or inflammation) -> \"gangrene\"", "the deadened place lost all its strength -> \"the deadened flesh corrupted the rest\""]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and mostly accurate apart from reversing 'turn their backs on' the prayers, while B gets the opening sentence wrong and reverses the meaning of the resurrection sentence, along with several smaller slips."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["uol hach heɔáan cú cilƀa (even the firmest heart trembles) -> 'the soul, thoroughly terrified, trembles'", "cà má c paymaéex kaholticéex (that we ought to first recognize) -> 'whom we do not first recognize'", "ú nuculintic ù mentic à uilaéex ... yumtzil iix ah yacunah (my purpose is to make you see, as a father and lover) -> 'Today he intends to show you, like a loving lord and father'", "Dios cú pocħol yáaƀ ti le nucul (how much God is insulted by the manner) -> 'how God is deeply offended in doctrine'", "mix huntul á uohelmá (you know, as no one else does) -> 'not one of us knows'", "ah pak keƀan cħuplal (the adulterous woman) -> 'the sinful woman'", "ti tulacal ù nummia hach yaé (throughout all his very bitter passion) -> 'in all their grievous afflictions'", "Le nuculóob ti Jesu-Cristo; inaix chucáanil cà ú tħanóob (the counsels of Christ, or more fully his words) -> 'The teachings of Jesus Christ; how perfect are his words'", "má yohel heƀic unchac ú nachcunzic (our understanding cannot set them aside) -> 'though we do not know how far it may reach'", "ú chunil nucul ti ú ɔiliƀ (the main model for imitating him) -> 'foundation of instruction in his writing'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["...prophesying a great sorrow of heart for when there shall be"], "mistranslated": ["mazuƀtalil pectaƀil (the shameful abomination) -> 'detestable shamelessness' (a slight slip)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is complete and reads the sermon's sense correctly throughout, with only a meta note that brings in text from the previous page, while A has several misreadings that change who speaks and what is meant, such as 'we do not first recognize', 'not one of us knows' and 'his writing'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["and that fervent trust"], "mistranslated": ["ti zeƀchilah (quickly/urgently) -> \"in prophecy\"", "táan ú zeƀchitic (hastening/stirring up) -> \"while prophesying\"", "tac ú caxtcechóob (until they seek you) -> \"until they find you\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["le káaxóob (the forests/wild country) -> \"the mountains\"", "utial á zàat-zahul ti h keƀanéex (for your pardoning of sinners) -> \"for the forgiveness of our sins\"", "cá uohléex tu hahil (when you truly know) -> \"so that we truly understand\""]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations are complete, but A adds a phrase that is not in the source (\"fervent trust\") and twice renders zeƀ- as prophecy, while B's slips are small, such as following the Latin \"montes\" (mountains) instead of the Maya \"káax\" (forests)."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Cħencħentucléex ú chucáanil (consider its fullness/whole matter carefully) -> 'Ponder the rest carefully'", "hi hach utzilil iix ɔoyanil (out of frailty and weakness) -> 'out of goodness and weakness'", "halkaƀil ti leyli uolah (deliberate freedom of the will itself) -> 'a surrender of that same will'", "zalcunah cá cú cħiczic ù chucáanil (an affront that completes the measure) -> 'an insult that makes all the rest appear even more clearly'", "ua uolticéexi káatic (if you are willing to ask) -> 'if we are willing to ask for it'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["of guilt"], "mistranslated": ["mayli ti ú cuxtaƀal le confesaré (before confession is made / put into practice) -> 'before you are restored to life by confession'", "cá iztic c luƀuléex, c tħanicéex (as soon as we fall, we call upon him) -> 'we easily fall, if we call upon Him'", "hach mukanil ti yanal (great force from another) -> 'great vulnerability to another'", "yacuntaháanóob tioklal le ú xocolilóob (multiplied by the number) -> 'weighed against the number'", "c paymaéex tħanicéex (we must call promptly) -> 'we urge you to call promptly'"]}, "better": "tie", "comment": "Both translations are complete and each has a handful of small slips of sense in different places: A garbles the will-freedom contrast and the closing clause about filling the measure but gets right 'as soon as we fall' and 'multiplied', while B gets those two clauses right but misrenders the falling, multiplying and obligation clauses."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé (masters treat servants as children of God) -> 'Just as God acts toward His children'", "báax cú uetħic chucanil éma leti má cimzah (what else does it forbid besides killing) -> 'what does it completely forbid, namely, not to kill?'", "Má ú mentáal ti mix máac lob (that no harm be done to anyone; i.e. it forbids doing harm) -> 'Doing no harm to anyone', which gives the wrong polarity in answer to 'what does it forbid'", "ti laóobé (serving God in them) -> 'through them' (slight)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ú nacuntic (injures/provokes) -> 'who loathes'", "hach kanáan (extreme need) -> 'great need' (slight weakening)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gets the catechism's sense right: masters treat servants as children of God, and the commandment forbids more than killing. A gets the masters answer and the fifth-commandment question wrong."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["especially"], "mistranslated": ["xmá tiblil (indecency / lack of propriety) -> \"Idleness\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["c meyahtbaóob (our labours/occupations) -> \"our pious devotions\"", "leitió (with this, singular) -> \"through them\""]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both are complete and close to the source; A wrongly renders 'xmá tiblil' (indecency) as 'idleness' and adds 'especially', while B's main slip is turning 'our occupations' into 'pious devotions', so B is slightly more faithful."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["In heláancuntah ƀahun (how he changed/overturned this) -> 'how differently did your Redeemer act' (loose)", "napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex (that it may serve as remedy / that you recognize it) -> 'accustom yourselves to it or recognize it' (doubtful)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["hun hatzul ... ú láak (on one side ... on the other) contrast flattened to 'In like manner ... likewise'"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Ahzáat-zahuléex / Ahzáat-zah zipiléex (your Redeemer / Forgiver of your sins) -> 'our Savior' / 'our Forgiver of sins'", "cú yiláal cá ... yanti cáach (it is seen that he held [irreverence a grave sin]) -> 'showing that our Forgiver acted thus because...'", "le Mesa (the table) -> 'the tables'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both are complete and close to the source, but A keeps the second-person possessives and the 'one side / other side' structure, while B changes 'your' to 'our' and turns the description of the scene into a looser paraphrase."}

'from them come')"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["because from them come more thoughts and motions, evil -> \"Because their thoughts and motions are exceedingly evil\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'tipáan' (more): desire to have more riches", "'or something else' (éma ú yanal)", "'tipáan' (more) in the answer about evil thoughts arising"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["desire to have more riches or something else by good means -> \"desire to have riches, other than for a good purpose\"", "by a particular commandment (y pelelil almahtħan) -> \"by these commandments\"", "desires that are not by right means and immoderate (taɔmanzahóob) -> \"coveted unlawfully and through dishonest means\""]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A keeps the sense of the first question ('more riches or something else by honest means') and of 'a particular commandment', but blurs the final answer of that section; B gets the first question wrong and turns 'particular commandment' into 'these commandments'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["the sense of 'great' (ni ma) in what the person receives through the Bull", "the Bull being referred to as 'his/one's' (ru bula) is flattened, a minor point"], "added": ["\"take effect\""], "mistranslated": ["pa ꜭhavomariçabal hay (house of purification, a gloss for Purgatory) -> \"or in the hospital\"", "tu gunih vi ra hilaxic paru vi (the reading/pronouncement over him can be done) -> \"its reading over him ... take effect\"", "chupam ruꜫitahic (at the time/hour of a person's need or death) -> \"in visiting a person\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"is requested\""], "mistranslated": ["ra hilaxic paru vi (its reading/pronouncement over one) -> \"its absolution is requested over one\"", "ruꜫitahic (uncertain) -> \"in the hour of a person's death\", which is plausible but more specific than the source supports"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B renders the passage more fully and correctly glosses ꜭhavomariçabal hay as the house of purification, while A wrongly gives it as 'hospital' and is looser in several places."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the sense of 'ah ahil' (those who recount or enumerate their sins) is lost"], "added": ["\"merrymakers\""], "mistranslated": ["tu coꜭhih yi ru nima hoyeuaxic ru vaꜭh (one receives great mercy upon oneself) -> \"he shall take patience, and it is greatly to be honored, its presence\"", "ah ghumum, ah ꜫatat gux (contrite people with burning hearts) -> \"proud, hard-hearted\"", "ah biꜯ, ah ahil ꜭhiroꜫexic ronohel kamac (those who weep and recount all their sins) -> \"songsters, merrymakers, weeping over all our sins\"", "tan ti giꜯ ruçaꜭh Padre Saçerdote (when the priest's absolution or pronouncement is finished) -> \"while the Father Priest is giving absolution\"", "ru ꜭhoh mil (its proper manner) -> \"its proper benefit\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"and visitation\""], "mistranslated": ["pokonariçabal (torment or suffering) -> \"the instrument of torment\""]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Kaqchikel closely and reads the contrition and absolution passages correctly, while A gets several key passages badly wrong ('patience', 'proud, hard-hearted', 'songsters, merrymakers')."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["accumulated"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhi ruꜫatatibal ga ka gux (with the burning of our heart) -> \"with the contrition <gloss>breaking</gloss> of our hearts\"", "paru ꜭhij (from its mouth/edge) -> \"from the burning heat\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page, but B renders the heart couplet correctly as 'burning' and 'paru ꜭhij' correctly as 'the mouth', where A says 'contrition/breaking' and 'burning heat', and A also adds 'accumulated'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["that is where one receives the indulgence (\"indulgence\" is supplied; the source breaks off at \"lo-\")"], "mistranslated": ["ka ꜯol ꜫomibal kij (likely 'our means of repaying/restitution') -> 'our means of curing and healing ourselves'", "ꜭhica nihraꜭh ça ꜭhic rumac (sins lightened/remitted) -> 'sins have already been washed and made white' (doubtful)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["ka ru la huna (the 'ten years' one would remain in Purgatory)", "ka ꜯol ꜫomibal kij as a means of repayment, replaced by an unrelated phrase"], "added": ["\"wasting their days instead of\"", "\"puts an end to this debt\"", "\"If someone must go\""], "mistranslated": ["yiriçabal (affliction/suffering) -> 'the purification of'", "ꜭhavomariçabal hay (house of cleansing/purification) -> 'the house of torment' (twice)", "mani xkilih (we did not heed/care) -> 'they did not finish it'", "first-person plural 'we/our' -> third person 'someone/they'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the source closely and correctly renders the ten years and 'house of purification', while B mistranslates the key term as 'house of torment', drops the ten years, and adds phrases that are not in the source."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["made white and clean"], "mistranslated": ["tihath (is being preached/proclaimed) -> \"being distributed\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["again"], "mistranslated": ["(lo)ꜫobal, hoyevabal (instruments of mercy and compassion) -> \"a ransom ... and an act of mercy\", with the note glossing ꜫobal as 'recompense'", "ꜭhi kih (for us) -> \"for them\"", "ꜭhivi (to you) -> \"to them\"", "tihath (is being preached/proclaimed) -> \"offered\""]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and close to the source, with only a small embellishment, while B misreads lo-ꜫobal as 'ransom', changes the persons ('us'/'you' become 'them') and adds 'again'."}
